eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 一行 pipe

headline.zh:
让云端 Coding Agent
安全碰你的内网私有库
headline.en:
Let cloud coding agents
touch your private repos, safely

sub.zh: 坐在 Agent 与模型之间，出境前只对通过校验位的中国 PII 做字段级掩码，业务逻辑原样进模型，每一次脱敏都落进审计日志。
sub.en: It sits between your agent and the model; before anything egresses it masks only checksum-validated Chinese PII field-by-field, leaves the business logic untouched, and logs every mask.

title.zh: 只掩真的 PII，不碰你的业务逻辑
title.en: Masks only real PII, never your logic

body.zh: 身份证走 GB 11643 校验位、银行卡走 Luhn、统一社会信用代码走 mod-31——只对通过校验的串做字段级掩码，普通 18 位计数器原样保留，业务代码一个字节不动地送达模型。
body.en: ID cards pass GB 11643, bank cards pass Luhn, USCC passes mod-31 — only checksum-valid strings are masked field-by-field. A plain 18-digit counter is left alone, and your business code reaches the model byte-for-byte.

chips: › 校验位级 CN-PII 识别
› 字段级掩码 · 业务逻辑原样

title.zh: 一行 pipe，出境前就掩好

body.zh: cat 文件 | redactgate mask，出站文本里的身份证/手机号就地掩成 1101**********8515，输出可直接喂给 Agent，零配置；也可起一个本地 HTTP 代理拦出站请求体。
body.en: cat file | redactgate mask and the id-card / phone fields in the outbound text become 1101**********8515 on the spot — pipe it straight to your agent, zero config. Or run a local HTTP proxy that masks request bodies before forwarding.

chips: › 本地 HTTP 代理可选

title.zh: 每一次脱敏都有审计留痕
title.en: Every mask leaves an audit trail

body.zh: 每掩一个字段就往 JSONL 审计日志写一行——谁、在哪一行、什么类型、掩成什么样，绝不含原始 PII。合规复核一条 grep 就能看清。
body.en: Every masked field appends one JSONL line — who, which line, what type, what it was masked to — never the raw PII. A compliance reviewer can trace the whole trail with one grep.

chips: › 只记掩码 · 不留原文

title.zh: 自定义你行业的 PII 规则

body.zh: 一份 YAML 规则里加你自己的识别器——员工号、项目代号、内部主机名——按校验位或纯正则生效，团队规则一次下发，五类内置 CN-PII 之上即插即用。
body.en: Add your own recognizers in one YAML ruleset — employee ids, project codes, internal hostnames — gated by a checksum or plain regex, rolled out once across the team, layered on top of five built-in Chinese-PII types.

headline.zh: 让数据不出境，让 Agent 放手干
headline.en: Keep data onshore; let agents do their work

sub.zh: 开源、Apache 2.0、无付费墙。出站脱敏这一核心动作，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, Apache 2.0, no paywall. The core act of masking on egress is never gated.

tag.zh: 给 Claude Code / Codex 接的本地出站脱敏网关
tag.en: A local outbound redaction gateway for Claude Code / Codex
